name: Shell Arisen Sorcerer
body:
Shell Arisen Sorcerer CR 20

XP 307,200
CE Medium humanoid (human)
Init +8; Senses all-around vision (areas with cameras); Perception +17

DEFENSE

AC 30, touch 17, flat-footed 27 (+4 armor, +4 deflection, +2 Dex, +1 dodge, +9 natural)
hp 217 (20d6+145)
Fort +16, Ref +11, Will +19; +4 morale bonus vs. undead spells and spell-like abilities; DR 5/—; Immune cold, nonlethal damage, paralysis, sleep

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee quarterstaff +9/+4 (1d6–1)
Bloodline Spell-like Abilities (CL 20th; concentration +24)

11/day—grave touch (10 rounds)
3/day—grasp of the dead (20d6 slashing, DC 28)
1/day—incorporeal form (20 rounds)

Sorcerer Spells Known (CL 20th; concentration +24, save DC 14 + spell-level, +2 necromancy)

9th (6/day)—energy drain, imprisonment, power word kill, wail of the banshee
8th (7/day)—create greater undead, horrid wilting, polar ray, protection from spells
7th (7/day)—finger of death, mass hold person, prismatic spray, waves of exhaustion
6th (7/day)—circle of death, create undead, flesh to stone, undeath to death
5th (7/day)—cloudkill, cone of cold, dominate person, teleport, waves of fatigue
4th (8/day)—animate dead, contagion, crushing despair, solid fog, wall of ice
3rd (8/day)—dispel magic, fireball, gaseous form, ray of exhaustion, vampiric touch
2nd (8/day)—blindness/deafness, invisibility, mirror image, scorching ray, spectral hand
1st (8/day)—chill touch, mage armor, magic missile, ray of enfeeblement, shield, shocking grasp
0 (at will)—acid splash, bleed, detect magic, disrupt undead, ghost sound, ray of frost, touch of fatigue

STATISTICS

Str 8, Dex 14, Con 20, Int 18, Wis 14, Cha 18
Base Atk +10; CMB +9; CMD 26
Feats Blind-Fight, Combat Casting, Eschew Materials, Mobility
Skills Autohypnosis +16, Bluff +18, Disguise +18, Fly +10, Intimidate +17, Sense Motive +16, Spellcraft +13, Use Magic Device +17
Languages Aklo, Binary, Common, Draconic
SQ bloodline arcana (corporeal undead affected by humanoid-affecting spells), one of us
Gear scrolls of darkvision (2), scrolls of fly (2), scroll of see invisibility, wand of cure moderate wounds (25 charges), quarterstaff, amulet of natural armor +4, belt of mighty constitution +6, cloak of resistance +3, headband of alluring charisma +6, ring of protection +4, robe of bones, diamonds for protection from spells (worth 1,500 gp), onyx gems (worth 2,000 gp), 4,650 gp
